INVALID_CNRS_FULL32_STAGE_A.rule: No capability interpretation. Preserve the invalid execution and localize only the validity/provenance defect.

SHAM_CNRS_FULL32_MISMATCH.rule: No capability interpretation. Localize measurement perturbation before another C_NRS court.

CNRS_FULL32_STAGE_A_ESTABLISHED_BOTH.rule: Both CONTROL and PROJECT pass. Use the simpler passing CONTROL C_NRS foundation for Stage-B design; projection is not required by this outcome.

CNRS_FULL32_STAGE_A_ESTABLISHED_CONTROL_.rule: CONTROL passes and PROJECT regresses. Stage-B design may use CONTROL only; inherited projector is forbidden as the default Stage-B repair.

CNRS_BASELINE_FAILURE_WITHOUT_PROJECTOR_.rule: Neither arm establishes Stage A and projector never actually engages. Do not open Stage B.

CNRS_FULL32_STAGE_A_RESCUED_BY_INHERITED.rule: C_NRS Stage A is established only under the exact inherited EXP-335 projector. A Stage-B design may inherit exactly this repair, prospectively frozen; no post-hoc projector substitution.

CNRS_FULL32_STAGE_A_NOT_ESTABLISHED.rule: Preserve the negative result. Do not open Stage B; only a distinct preregistered causal hypothesis may follow.
